pages.title: 7: Ender Crystals
pages.notes: Ender crystals are a powerful resource that can be used in all kinds of advanced technology.$(br2)First you have to procure the $(item)Crystalline Liquid$() in the $(l:sim_5/2_wyrm_milk#darksteelmixer)Dark Steel Fluid Mixer$().$(br2)It is made by mixing $(item)Pure Calcium$(), $(item)Molten Emerald$() and $(item)Superheated Miasma$().

pages.text: You also have to chuck in a $(item)Compacted Crystal Chunk$(). Which contains a myriad of valuable gems, minerals & crystals.$(br2)Each bucket of $(item)Shimmering Crystalline$() can produce a bit over 3 $(item)Ender Crystals$().$(br2)Once you have the crystalline, all you need is to transpose it on top of a $(item)Pristine Enderman Matter$().
